chunks: A man asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and said to him: “I am a man who has debt, so should I borrow and perform hajj (pilgrimage)?”
So he said: “Yes, it is more effective in settling the debt.”

key_terms.أَقْضَى: more effective or more conducive to fulfillment and repayment
key_terms.ذُو دَيْنٍ: a person possessing debt; someone financially obligated to others
key_terms.فَأَتَدَيَّنُ: shall I incur debt; shall I borrow money
key_terms.لِلدَّيْنِ: for the debt; referring to settling what is owed

ai.seo_question: Can a person in debt borrow money to perform hajj (pilgrimage)?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling about a person in debt asking whether he may borrow in order to perform hajj (pilgrimage). Imām Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام answers affirmatively, stating that this is more conducive to the repayment of the debt.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2905 - A man asked Abu Abdullah (as): "I am a man in debt. Should I borrow money and perform Hajj?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, it is more effective in settling the debt."
